name: Being Born In Sin
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that humanity is inherently sinful from birth, as seen in Psalms 51:5 where David acknowledges being conceived in sin. This condition is evident from the earliest moments of life, with Psalms 58:3 describing the wicked as going astray from the womb. The universal nature of sin is affirmed in Romans 3:10 and 3:23, declaring that no one is righteous and all have sinned, falling short of God's glory. Even from youth, the human heart is inclined toward evil, as Genesis 8:21 highlights, underscoring the necessity of Christ's redemptive work for salvation.
